verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official Editor MCP server that lets AI assistants connect to a live Editor session to modify project data, verify results, and it provides 'PlayCanvas Skills' giving AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific development/verification workflows plus a scriptable Editor API and llms.txt docs for API Q&A — covering scaffolding, scripting, and engine-task assistance. However this is delivered via external AI agent connectivity (MCP/skills) rather than a built-in, native assistant UI inside the engine/editor itself. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party chat-based assistant embedded directly in the Editor UI, and independent hands-on reports validating the MCP/skills workflow in practice.
